description: Get high and low tide times and heights for a coastal place, for one day or up to a week, with the current water level and whether the tide is rising or falling. Use for "when is high tide in …", "low tide this weekend at …", "tide chart for …", "is the tide coming in?", and king-tide or minus-tide questions. Also returns sunrise, sunset and moon phase for each day. Identify the place with place (a name, optionally with a state), latitude + longitude, or station_id. If a name is not recognised the tool says so: call again with that place's latitude and longitude. Covers NOAA tide stations on US coasts and territories; times are local to the place and heights are above MLLW. Predictions are astronomical and exclude storm surge.

date.description: Local calendar date at the place, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today there.

days.description: How many consecutive local days to return, 1–7. Use 2–3 for "this weekend", 7 for "this week".

latitude.description: Latitude of the place being asked about, decimal degrees. Use with longitude when a place name is not recognised; approximate is fine.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place, decimal degrees (negative west).

place.description: The coastal place being asked about — a beach, harbor, bay, or town, optionally with a state: "Santa Cruz, CA".

station_id.description: 7-digit NOAA tide station ID, when already known from an earlier result.

units.description: imperial = feet, knots, °F (default). metric = meters, km/h, °C.
